The concept

A full page, built around the favourites

This demo turns the flavours visitors name in public listings into a complete visit — menu, gallery, and directions in one place.

The menu above lists visitor-reported favourites, not a verified menu, and every photo on this page is illustrative stock — not photography of this business. What this concept adds is structure: the favourites up front, the visit details in one place, and a clear next step at the bottom.

Lowe's Donuts and Bakery is a dedicated gluten-free, top 9+ allergen-free, and vegan bakery in Haverhill. Owner Nicole opened it in honour of her boys, who have over 25 food allergies — so no gluten or top-9 allergens ever come into the bakery. Flavours rotate monthly, and beyond donuts the case holds cookies, muffins, brownies, cupcakes, pies, coffee cakes, whoopie pies, and bi-scones. A second location in Newburyport has been announced — coming soon, not yet open.
